As a proof of this, the bidder should upload a single work order and corresponding work done certificate issued by the Competent Authority (Work done of previous years shall be given weight at 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: House keeping,removal of spillage coal periodical clearing of drains & disposal thereof at designated places in the Mill area of Units 5 to 8 and clearing of reject coal in the pits of unit 5 to 7 at RTPS.

itemList.description: Removal and disposal of mill spillage coal of Units-5 to 8 collected around the mill and mill motors, mill reject bay of all four units to the coal yard including loading, unloading and stacking as directed including cost of all labours & materials etc., complete with all leads and lifts.

Cleaning of the floor surface at 0.00 mt by sweeping of concrete/plinth protection/open area including flagging walls, roofs, gates, grills (External area) and removing of grass/weeds etc., as directed by engineer in charge including cost of all materials such as broom stick etc., complete with all lead and lifts.
Cleaning the Drains: removal coal dust & debris including wet/dry ash, from drains including cost of all labours and materials etc., complete with all lead and lifts.
Disposing of the debris, Ash and dust collected from the above said areas including loading and unloading and disposing the same with all leads and lifts.
Removal of reject coal in pits of Unit-5,6, & 7 (XRP-803 Mills)
